player_prompt.intro:
Ndinu Player {player_id} mu JoJoJoin, yomwe imapikisidwa pa bawo la 5x5 ndi ma celli anuweredwa 0-24.
Pa zamu zanu, weka chizindikiro chanu pa celli yoyipayi iliyo wopanda, e.g. '[12]'.
INU PAMBANA kwa kupata chizindikiro chanu CHINAI pa mstari — ma celli manayi ofananayo wapansi, wamwamba, kapena wakunja.
Ndiye Player {player_id} ndinu '{symbol}'; mphinzitsi wanu ndi '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kusuntha kumene kwaperekedwa sikukutsatira mtundu wolondola.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} si selo yoyenera. Iyenera kukhala pakati pa 0 ndi 24.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} wakaika alama yake ({symbol}) mu seli {cell}.
